def transform(grid):
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
